snippet.title: Turbo Sub - Arcade -  1985 - First time playing
snippet.description:
The '85 list continues!
Easy to pick up difficult to master.

Turbo Sub. Completely different than most '85 games I played. Maybe similar to Space Harrier but not quite. You control the guns on a submarine. It has the awful inverted Y-axis, makes it a extra challenge to play. Game was pretty fun. It talks non stop. Difficulty; The tractor beam area seemed impossible first try. I quit, and tried it again and beat it easily the next try.  Some obstacles just seemed impossible to dodge. It was pretty fun for a few rounds, not sure I would play it again, unless I tried 2 player mode with a friend.
Entertainment Sciences RIP System
